developmentDiagnostics: AGP9 library sourceSets resource accessor cast failed during initial configuration; retained stack trace. Replaced unnecessary test-resource DSL access with test-task fixture-path system property. Same fixture still participates in SQLDelight migration verification and host reads.

SQLDelight SQLite3.18 parser rejected a CHECK referencing a newly added ALTER column. Use generated ALTER ADD DEFAULT1 supported by both SQLite and the parser; positive versions remain enforced at repository construction/open, with an invalid-version regression. Public cache keeps its SQL CHECK. No failed acceptance test or required invariant was waived.

First storage run refused raw JDBC drivers: foreign_keys is connection-local and SQLDelight opens per operation. Configure it on every connection through the host adapter property; shared boundary verifies within its transaction and explicitly refuses a non-FK driver. Retained all 11 initial failing test diagnostics/JUnit XML, then passed full regressions.

Artifact checker initially assumed all JAR classes were Java17; actual inventory showed AGP's R.class is Java8 while all 37 storage/SQLDelight classes are Java17. Corrected checker to assert both exact categories; no build target changed.

An added host-JVM assertion used Runtime.version(), unavailable in Android's compile bootclasspath. Replaced it with java.specification.version assertion, preserving required JVM21 execution. Clean locked full rerun and artifact checks pass afterward.
